object.description: This object models a generic optical interface. It defines an {{object|Interface}} object that models a layer 1 optical interface that is capable of transporting Ethernet packets. For historical reasons, the data model definition is based on parts of {{bibref|G.988}}. However, it is not intended to model anything specific to IEEE PON or ITU-T PON technologies. Note that this object is not intended to model the optical transceiver either.
